Every treatment we offer starts with these four parts. Keep scrolling to take a molar apart.

Enamel
The hard outer shell. It is the hardest substance in the human body.
Dentin
The softer layer underneath that gives the tooth its shape.
Pulp
Nerves and blood vessels. When it gets infected, it hurts.
Roots
Hold the tooth firmly in your jawbone.

How an implant replaces a missing tooth

  1. Step 1 of 4

    The implant

    A small titanium post is placed in the jawbone where the root used to be. Over a few months, the bone bonds to it.

  2. Step 2 of 4

    The abutment

    A connector is fitted on top of the implant. It rises through the gum to hold the new tooth.

  3. Step 3 of 4

    The crown

    A crown made for your mouth, shaped and coloured to match your other teeth, is fixed onto the abutment.

  4. Step 4 of 4

    A tooth that works like your own

    You can bite, chew and smile normally again. With good care, an implant can last for many years.

Everything about implants

Root canal treatment saves an infected tooth

  1. Step 1 of 4

    Infection reaches the pulp

    Deep decay or a crack lets bacteria into the pulp. This is what causes the throbbing pain.

  2. Step 2 of 4

    The canals are cleaned

    With the tooth numbed, the dentist removes the infected pulp through a small opening and cleans each canal with fine files.

  3. Step 3 of 4

    Filled and sealed

    The clean canals are filled with a rubber-like material and sealed so bacteria cannot get back in.

  4. Step 4 of 4

    Your own tooth, kept

    The tooth stays in place and works normally. Your dentist may recommend a crown to protect it.

Everything about root canal treatment

Crowns and veneers

  1. Crowns

    A crown fits over a tooth that is cracked, heavily filled or weakened, and gives it back its full shape and strength.

    Everything about crowns

  2. Veneers

    A veneer is a thin shell bonded to the front of a tooth. It covers chips, small gaps and stains that whitening cannot lift.

    Everything about veneers

Smile studio

  1. Braces

    Brackets and a thin wire apply gentle, steady pressure, moving crowded or crooked teeth into line over several months.

    Everything about braces

  2. Whitening

    A supervised treatment that lifts years of tea, coffee and smoking stains.

  3. Dentures

    A complete denture replaces every tooth in a jaw on a natural-looking gum base. A partial denture fills the gaps when some of your own teeth remain.

Treatment and comfort

Does root canal treatment hurt?

The tooth is numbed with local anaesthetic first, so most patients feel pressure rather than pain. It can feel tender for a few days afterwards. If you have severe swelling, or trouble swallowing or breathing, go to the nearest emergency department.

How long does an implant take?

It usually happens in stages over a few months: placing the implant, letting the bone heal around it, then fitting the crown. The dentist will give you a timeline after checking your bone.

Is whitening safe?

Yes, when it is done or supervised by a dentist. Some people feel short-lived sensitivity. Whitening doesn't change the colour of existing crowns, veneers or fillings.

Do you treat children?

Yes. We see patients of every age, from a child's first check-up to dentures for grandparents.

Booking and costs

What are your timings?

Please call or WhatsApp +92 333 9202134 and the clinic will tell you today's timings.

Why are prices not listed on the website?

Every mouth is different. The cost depends on what the dentist finds at your check-up and which treatment you choose, so a fixed price list would only be a guess. After examining you, the dentist explains your options and what each costs before any treatment starts.

How do I book an appointment?

Use the booking assistant on this page, or message +92 333 9202134 on WhatsApp. The clinic replies to confirm your time.
